mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here, because together, we’re about to dive into a journey that just might change how you see the world around you. Imagine waking up in a place where technology isn’t just something you use—it’s the very air you breathe. Everything moves fast. New tools, new ways of working, and even new ways of connecting with people—sometimes it can feel like you’re barely keeping up. But what if, instead of feeling left behind, you could learn to ride that wave of change? That’s exactly what we’ll be exploring as we step into the pages of Live Digital or Be Irrelevant by A.K. Smith-Ford. This isn’t just about mastering the latest gadget or app. It’s about discovering how embracing digital transformation can reshape not just our skills, but our identity, our communities, and our sense of purpose. We’ll walk alongside real stories of adaptation—moments of doubt, sparks of discovery, and victories that make you want to punch the air. Through Smith-Ford’s insights, you’ll see how the journey to digital fluency is as much about building resilience and curiosity as it is about understanding tech. So, if you’ve ever wondered what it really means to thrive in today’s digital world, you’re in the right place. Let’s explore this new frontier together—and maybe, just maybe, discover how to stay not just relevant, but empowered, in a world that never stops changing.
